$comment: The Story Kit anchors: hand-tuned Character Forge sheets (scripts/forge/anchors) the builder picks the nearest of for each cast member (cast[].anchor) and varies with the story's sheet. Every id is in storykit/pack/schema.mjs ANCHORS; an archetype there without an entry here has no sheet yet. Invented people only. gates: the forge's gates (scripts/forge/gates.mjs) on the committed forge, 4 Nov 2026 (v2.5 MV: materials and variety; 11 of 12 pass, .scratch/storykit/shots/MV-*); grade: against the shipped Mr. Big (A) in the study set (.scratch/storykit/shots/MV-*, AN-*, HD-*, HB-*).

anchors.label: Old boss
anchors.who: man, 71, heavy (a belly in profile), Mediterranean-Levantine, balding grey, full grey beard, three-piece suit
anchors.pick: an older man with money and power: a crime boss, a landlord, a club owner, a retired judge, anyone in a suit who is used to being obeyed
anchors.gates: fail: cloth (the base suit's shirt and trousers in sitTalk, 93; it was 82 before he was made heavier)

anchors.label: Young hero
anchors.who: man, 24, 182 cm, slim athletic, West African / Latin American, short curls, wide-set eyes, broad nose, grey hoodie and jeans
anchors.pick: a young man in his twenties who carries the story: a driver, a courier, a hustler, a student, the player

anchors.label: Grandmother
anchors.who: woman, 77, small (157 cm), Caribbean, deep brown skin, silver side-parted crop, round glasses, knit top and loose trousers
anchors.pick: an older woman: a grandmother, a neighbour at the window, a landlady, a church elder

anchors.label: Cop
anchors.who: man, 46, 186 cm, broad stocky, Mexican-American, close-set eyes, wide jaw, buzz cut, black moustache, navy uniform, peaked cap, boots
anchors.pick: anyone in uniform with authority: a police officer, a security guard, a transit cop, a sergeant

anchors.label: Street-wise teen
anchors.who: boy, 17, 174 cm, small and slim, short face, narrow jaw, Dominican-American, short twists, black hoodie, black track pants, white and red sneakers
anchors.pick: a teenager who knows the block: a lookout, a runner, a kid brother, a skater, a witness who saw too much

anchors.label: Young mother
anchors.who: woman, 29, petite (152 cm), Filipina-American, short face, long straight black hair, heather hoodie, light jeans, white sneakers, idles on her phone
anchors.pick: a young woman in everyday clothes: a mother, a sister, a girlfriend, a shop worker, a student, a caller who needs help

anchors.label: Office worker
anchors.who: woman, 36, tall (175 cm), slim, Indian-British, long face, long brown hair, dark glasses, slate knit top, charcoal trousers, black sneakers
anchors.pick: a professional in office clothes: an analyst, an accountant, a lawyer's clerk, a journalist, a whistle-blower, a manager

anchors.label: Chef
anchors.who: woman, 43, stocky and strong, Mexican-American, dark bun, white chef's jacket, black trousers, work boots
anchors.pick: a cook or a restaurant owner, anyone who works a kitchen or a food truck (add an apron in the story's sheet only if it passes)

anchors.label: Club promoter
anchors.who: man, 31, tall (191 cm), average build, Brazilian, light olive skin, long narrow face, hooked nose, black side-parted hair, stubble, black fitted jacket, black trousers, white sneakers
anchors.pick: a man of the night: a club promoter, a bouncer's boss, a DJ, a fixer, a dealer, a smooth talker in dark clothes

anchors.label: Nurse
anchors.who: woman, 52, Nigerian-American, deep brown skin, short black curls, wide jaw, navy scrubs (tee and loose trousers), white sneakers
anchors.pick: a nurse, a paramedic, a care worker, an orderly, anyone in scrubs or a working woman in her forties or fifties

anchors.label: Mechanic
anchors.who: man, 58, 180 cm, broad and strong, Irish-American, balding auburn going grey, grey stubble, blue-grey work shirt, dark trousers, work boots
anchors.pick: a man who works with his hands: a mechanic, a tow driver, a builder, a dock worker, a garage owner, a fence

anchors.label: Retired veteran
anchors.who: man, 72, small and wiry (168 cm), Japanese-American, long narrow face, white buzz cut, white moustache, olive field jacket, dark trousers, boots, a cane
anchors.pick: an older man with a past: a retired soldier, a retired bus driver, a park-bench regular, a grandfather, a watchman
